He played college basketball for the [[Syracuse Orange men's basketball|Syracuse Orange]]. Lydon attended [[New Hampton School]] in [[New Hampton, New Hampshire]]. He committed to [[Syracuse University]] to play [[college basketball]].[http://www.syracuse.com/orangebasketball/index.ssf/2014/10/tyler_lydon_syracuse_basketball_recruit_is_a_confessed_country_boy_spurred_by_co.html Syracuse basketball recruit Tyler Lydon a confessed country boy spurred by competition] As a freshman at Syracuse, Lydon averaged 10.1 points, 6.3 rebounds and 1.8 blocks per game.[http://www.democratandchronicle.com/story/sports/college/2016/03/29/shoeless-tyler-lydon-comes-age-syracuse/82395800/ 'Shoeless' Tyler Lydon comes of age for Syracuse][http://www.syracuse.com/orangebasketball/index.ssf/2016/05/tyler_lydon_could_become_oranges_next_star_syracuse_basketball_player_evaluation.html Tyler Lydon could become Orange's next star ] As a sophomore, he averaged 13.2 points, 8.6 rebounds and 1.4 blocks per game.
